classification.difficultyReason: Directly translate taught set notation into shaded regions, including intersections with complements; no new strategy or inference is required.

content.prompt: Shade the Venn diagrams with the set.

spec.description: Universal-set rectangle with overlapping circles A left and B right; supplied answer shading removed.
spec.mathematics: Shade all of A, including its intersection with B.

answer.short: Shade all of $A$, including the overlap.
answer.worked: $A$ contains both the $A$-only region and $A\cap B$. Shade both regions.

spec.description: Complete Venn diagram with the whole left circle shaded.
Unshaded matching two-set Venn response diagram.

answer.short: Shade all of $B$, including the overlap.
answer.worked: $B$ contains both the $B$-only region and $A\cap B$. Shade both regions.

spec.description: Complete Venn diagram with the whole right circle shaded.
Unshaded matching two-set Venn response diagram.

answer.short: Shade only the overlap of $A$ and $B$.
answer.worked: $A\cap B$ contains elements belonging to both sets. Shade only the common region.

spec.description: Complete Venn diagram with only the lens-shaped intersection shaded.
Unshaded matching two-set Venn response diagram.

answer.short: Shade both circles, including the overlap.
answer.worked: $A\cup B$ contains elements in $A$ or $B$ or both. Shade every region inside either circle.

spec.description: Complete Venn diagram with both circles shaded.
Unshaded matching two-set Venn response diagram.

answer.worked: $A\cap\overline{B}$ contains elements in $A$ and outside $B$. Shade the left crescent, leaving the overlap unshaded.

spec.description: Complete Venn diagram with only the left crescent shaded.
Unshaded matching two-set Venn response diagram.

answer.worked: $\overline{A}\cap B$ contains elements outside $A$ and in $B$. Shade the right crescent, leaving the overlap unshaded.

spec.description: Complete Venn diagram with only the right crescent shaded.
Unshaded matching two-set Venn response diagram.
spec.mathematics: Shade everything in the universal set outside A.

answer.worked: $\overline{A}$ contains every element of the universal set that is not in $A$. Shade the $B$-only region and the region outside both circles.

spec.description: Complete Venn diagram shaded everywhere outside the left circle.
spec.mathematics: Complement of A relative to the universal set.

spec.description: Unshaded matching two-set Venn response diagram.
spec.mathematics: Shade the region outside both circles.

answer.short: Shade the region outside both circles.
answer.worked: $\overline{A}\cap\overline{B}$ contains elements outside $A$ and outside $B$. Shade only the region belonging to neither set.

spec.description: Complete Venn diagram with only the region outside both circles shaded.
spec.mathematics: Intersection of the complements of A and B.
